records.subject: Se substitution at O sites in BiCuSeO
records.object: Dense intragranular lattice dislocations in Pb-doped BiCuSeO
records.quote: Herein, taking BiCuSeO oxide as an example, the present work reports a successful construction of dense lattice dislocations in BiCuSeO by self-doping of Se at the O site (i.e., SeO self-substitution), and achieves plain optimization of the thermoelectric properties with only external Pb doping.

records.subject: CeO2/a-Al2O3 semiconductor/insulator heterostructure electrolyte
records.object: Ionic conductivity up to 0.127 S cm−1
